notes: Shipwide soundboard is now COMMAND-only and no longer hides itself: select a ship net (UEES TIBER, UEENS MINERVA) and the panel appears under the roster on COMMS, telling you to tune the net if you haven't. Non-COMMAND operators don't see it, and the restriction is enforced in the app process too, not just the UI. Also: the Windows minimise/maximise/close buttons now take their colours from the live theme instead of a hardcoded older palette, so they match the header in night, day and custom modes.
